name: mongodb
description: MongoDB: find, count, distinct and aggregate with Extended JSON, list databases and collections, and insert/update/replace/delete (agent tools read-only unless MONGODB_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

nodes.title: Find documents
nodes.description: Find documents in a collection with an Extended JSON filter, projection and sort. Returns up to `limit` documents (max 1000, and at most MONGODB_MAX_RESULT_BYTES) and a next_cursor for the next page.

database.description: Database name; defaults to MONGODB_DATABASE or the database in the connection string

filter.description: Query filter in Extended JSON, e.g. {"status": "paid", "_id": {"$oid": "65a1f0c2e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6"}, "created": {"$gte": {"$date": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
